WITH item_rev AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost) AS gross_profit_2025,
  100.0 * (SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost)) / SUM(r.revenue) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS o
JOIN item_rev AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
